appendPreviouslyReservedComponents.name: Protected lifecycle role

behaviorChecks.assertion: Protected lifecycle via NATS, bounded ordered exact-owned start/stop and failed-member recovery; no external membership mutation.
behaviorChecks.description: Protected lifecycle via NATS, bounded ordered exact-owned start/stop and failed-member recovery; no external membership mutation.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: Actual native Linux/macOS and WSL scoped NATS/process/Compose fixtures as required; no mock or cross-build substitute.

migrationChecks: Retain legacy source, caller interfaces, credentials and data; no legacy business store conversion in this slice.
Keep the new namespace and profile ownership explicit; never let a fixture or partial implementation qualify a later owner.
currentBehavior: The real lifecycle actor publishes its own readiness and four observed peers through NATS.
Its current command handler supports announce only; process controls and complete recovery qualification remain separate.
appendPreviouslyReservedComponents.reusePlan: Retain the fixed role and shared stateless protocol; integrate only approved protected lifecycle controls without external membership writes.
enhancements: Complete the originally planned bounded lifecycle and failed-member recovery contract, with actual owned processes and denial tests.
limitations: Current observation slice is not full KERN-02-C01 acceptance.

appendPreviouslyReservedComponents.name: Protected exported-status role

behaviorChecks.assertion: Consistent late-subscriber snapshot/revisioned update, gap/reconnect/stale/slow-consumer tests using accepted L04 reply; kernel exports information only.
behaviorChecks.description: Consistent late-subscriber snapshot/revisioned update, gap/reconnect/stale/slow-consumer tests using accepted L04 reply; kernel exports information only.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: Actual native Linux/macOS and WSL scoped NATS/process/Compose fixtures as required; no mock or cross-build substitute.

migrationChecks: Retain legacy source, caller interfaces, credentials and data; no legacy business store conversion in this slice.
Keep the new namespace and profile ownership explicit; never let a fixture or partial implementation qualify a later owner.
currentBehavior: The real protected status actor publishes full kernel-info snapshots and updates with scope, incarnation, revision and expiry.
The frame reports four peer observations and does not invent business work or connected hubs.
appendPreviouslyReservedComponents.reusePlan: Keep protected kernel information separate from the surrounding owner-scoped L04 mapper and enforce the original permissions/freshness requirements.
enhancements: Complete late-subscriber, gap, reconnect, stale and slow-consumer qualification and the accepted outer status reply integration.
limitations: Kernel-info is not itself L04 or application readiness.
